_comment: Developer-owned clients can use a scoped pzk_* API key. Hosted clients such as Poke should use PolyZig OAuth instead of asking users to paste keys. Drop this into ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (macOS) or %APPDATA%/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (Windows), then restart Claude Desktop. Your agent gets every MCP tool whose scope your key holds. The `type: http` field is required by Anthropic's MCP JSON schema.
